_comment: Pre-crisis checklist items shown on each crisis page, grouped by crisisType. categoryId/itemId are used by the frontend to save checklist tick state in localStorage keyed as `${categoryId}.${itemId}.step-${index}`. steps are individually-checkable sub-items, not prose — description keeps the original full-sentence summary (used only as a fallback if steps is ever empty). GET /api/checklist loads this file into memory once at process start (see services/crisis_content_service.py).

items.task: Write down your bushfire plan
items.description: Note what will make you leave early, your main and backup routes, and who does what.

items.task: Choose where you'll go
items.description: Pick a lower-risk place, confirm you can stay there, and share the address with everyone.

items.task: Pack an emergency kit
items.description: Include water, a torch, batteries, first-aid items, a charged power bank, medication and food. Keep it where everyone can grab it.
steps: Keep the kit somewhere everyone can grab it

items.task: Gather your important documents
items.description: Collect ID, insurance details and prescriptions. Keep copies in a waterproof bag and tell someone where they are.

items.task: Name a helper for each child or dependant
items.description: Pack their medication, clothes and comfort items, and practise leaving together.

items.task: Get your pets ready to travel
items.description: Keep a carrier or lead handy and pack food, water and medication.

items.task: Plan for medication and access needs
items.description: List the medication and equipment that must come with you, and arrange help for mobility or communication needs.
steps: List medication that must come with you
List equipment that must come with you

items.task: Write down key phone numbers on paper
items.description: Include household, carer and support-service contacts. Keep a copy in your kit and give one to another person.
steps: Keep a copy in your kit
Give a copy to another person

items.task: Check your local flood risk
items.description: Find out if your home and usual routes are flood-prone. Choose a safer place on higher ground and write down a route that avoids low-lying roads and crossings.
steps: Find out if your home is flood-prone
Find out if your usual routes are flood-prone
Choose a safer place on higher ground
Write down a route that avoids low-lying roads and crossings

items.task: Write down your household contact plan
items.description: Pick one contact in your household and one outside the area, and note their phone numbers. Agree on a meeting spot in case phones don't work.
steps: Agree on a meeting spot in case phones don't work

items.task: Pack an emergency kit
items.description: Include water, a torch, batteries, a charged power bank, medication, first-aid items and food. Store it above likely flood level.
steps: Store the kit above likely flood level

items.task: Plan which items to move higher
items.description: List the documents, medicines and valuables to lift out of reach of water. Choose where they'll go and have waterproof bags or containers ready.

items.task: Name a helper for each child or dependant
items.description: Pack their medication, clothes and comfort items. Explain the safer place in calm, simple words.
steps: Explain the safer place in calm, simple words

items.task: Get your pets ready to move
items.description: Keep a carrier or lead handy and pack food, water and medication. Find a safer destination that accepts pets.
steps: Find a safer destination that accepts pets

items.task: Plan for medication and access needs
items.description: Keep medication and prescriptions ready to grab, and arrange help for mobility or communication needs. Store key instructions in a waterproof bag.
steps: Store key instructions in a waterproof bag

items.task: Write down emergency numbers on paper
items.description: Include VICSES 132 500 and your household contacts, and keep a copy in your kit. Call Triple Zero (000) for life-threatening danger.
steps: Keep a copy in your kit
Call Triple Zero (000) for life-threatening danger

items.task: Set aside 72 hours of supplies
items.description: Store drinking water and non-perishable food for at least three days. Add a battery-powered radio if you have one, and replace expired items regularly.
steps: Drinking water for at least three days
Non-perishable food for at least three days
Battery-powered radio if you have one

items.task: Put backup lighting somewhere easy to find
items.description: Place torches or battery lights in known spots, check they work, and keep spare batteries nearby.
steps: Torches or battery lights in known spots

items.task: Charge your phone and power bank
items.description: Fully charge both, check the cable fits your phone, and keep them together where you can reach them.
steps: Check the cable fits your phone
Keep them together where you can reach them

items.task: Write down your energy distributor's details
items.description: Find the name and faults number on your energy bill, write it on paper, and keep it with your household plan.
steps: Find the name on your energy bill
Find the faults number on your energy bill
Keep it with your household plan

items.task: Prepare supplies for children and dependants
items.description: Pack food, clothing, comfort items, medication and care instructions. Plan activities that don't need electricity.
steps: Plan activities that don't need electricity

items.task: Prepare supplies for pets
items.description: Set aside enough food and water, check their medication, and keep a carrier or lead accessible in case you need to leave.

items.task: Make a backup plan for powered medical equipment
items.description: Write down each device and how long its battery lasts. Ask the equipment provider what to do in a long outage, and keep their number on paper.
steps: Write down how long its battery lasts
Ask the equipment provider what to do in a long outage

items.task: Ask how to protect refrigerated medicine
items.description: Ask a pharmacist or healthcare professional how long your medicine can stay unrefrigerated. Write down their instructions and any backup storage plan.
steps: Ask how long your medicine can stay unrefrigerated
Write down any backup storage plan
